name: SEO Help Flow for ACF and Elementor
author: SEO HelpMarketing

sections.description:
SEO Help Flow for ACF and Elementor is the bridge your stack was missing: Advanced Custom Fields stay the source of truth, Elementor stays your design layer, and search engines get structured signals that mirror what you actually publish.

Built and maintained by SEO Help Marketing.

What you get (at a glance) 🎯

  • Dynamic ACF in Elementor — text, dynamic text, images, links, galleries, repeaters, and more.
  • Conditional logic — show or hide blocks based on real field values (no brittle hacks).
  • Global “ACF Logic” — consistent rules across widgets where it applies.
  • Presets & starter flows — save time on repeatable widget setups.
  • Structured data (JSON-LD) — turn ACF repeaters and fields into schema.org output search engines understand.

Why this matters for SEO 🔎

  • Content and markup stay aligned — headings, FAQ copy, article fields, and breadcrumbs can be driven by the same ACF data you edit in the back end.
  • Rich result–friendly patterns — output Article, FAQPage, WebPage, and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD from your fields, so eligible pages can speak Google’s language without duplicate “SEO boxes.”
  • Less duplicate maintenance — change the field once; front end and structured data can follow (where you wire them in Elementor).

Who it is for

  • Agencies and freelancers building Elementor + ACF sites at scale.
  • Teams that want maintainable dynamic layouts—not one-off shortcodes and fragile templates.
  • Anyone who cares about clean output, accessibility-friendly structure, and SEO that reflects real content.

Optional: Freemius

The plugin may load the Freemius SDK for optional opt-in, updates, or checkout.

All features in the WordPress.org build stay fully available—nothing is locked behind a license in this repository. See the Freemius Terms of Use and Freemius Privacy Policy.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher (see header above).
  • Elementor and Advanced Custom Fields (see Requires Plugins).
sections.installation:
1. Install Elementor and Advanced Custom Fields from WordPress.org (or your preferred compliant source) and activate them.
  2. Upload the SEO Help Flow for ACF and Elementor plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins → Add New screen.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Edit any page or template with Elementor.
  5. Open the widget panel and find the Help Flow category (label may follow your plugin settings).
  6. Drop in a widget (for example ACF Text or ACF JSON-LD (SEO)), select the ACF field to use, and publish.

Tip: Visit the plugin’s Getting Started screen in the WordPress admin for a guided overview.
sections.faq:
Do I need both Elementor and ACF?

Yes. The plugin is built specifically for sites that use Elementor for layout and Advanced Custom Fields for structured content. Both are listed under Requires Plugins.

How does the plugin help SEO if it is not a classic SEO plugin?

It connects your real content (ACF) to structured data and semantic output in Elementor. Instead of pasting static JSON-LD or duplicating text in a separate SEO box, you can drive Article, FAQ, WebPage, and breadcrumb schema from fields you already maintain—so SEO stays closer to what users see on the page.

Is everything free on WordPress.org?

Yes. Every widget and feature in this repository is available without paying. Optional Freemius flows (if you opt in) do not strip functionality from the hosted build.

How is this different from generic dynamic tags or shortcodes?

You get dedicated ACF widgets (repeaters, conditional logic, gallery, JSON-LD, presets) designed around field types and editor workflow—not one generic tag for everything.

Can I use this with other SEO plugins (Yoast, Rank Math, etc.)?

In many cases, yes. Avoid outputting conflicting duplicate JSON-LD for the same entity on the same page. Pick one source of truth per schema type (for example, either your SEO plugin or ACF JSON-LD (SEO) for FAQ)—whichever matches your workflow.

Can I translate the plugin?

Yes. Text domain: seohelp-flow-for-acf-and-elementor. Community translations can be contributed via translate.wordpress.org when available.

Will this slow down my site?

The plugin follows WordPress patterns for scripts and styles. As with any Elementor site, keep third-party widgets reasonable and test with your host and caching setup.

screenshots.caption: Help Flow in Elementor — the widget category with ACF Text, ACF Dynamic Text, Conditional Logic, ACF Image, ACF Link/Button, ACF Gallery, and ACF JSON-LD (SEO).
Core widgets in the panel — quick access to ACF Text, ACF Dynamic Text, ACF Repeater Builder, and Conditional Logic from the same category.
Edit ACF Text — Content tab: choose the ACF field (e.g. Text, Text Area), set the HTML tag (e.g. a paragraph), and options like Hide if empty.
ACF Repeater Builder — map a Repeater or Flexible field, pick an Elementor template for each row, and lay out items in a grid (columns, gap, responsive controls).
Conditional Logic — define when a block shows: conditions such as equals, not equals, is empty, or is not empty on the selected ACF field.
More field types in one widget — ACF Field dropdown including Text, Number, Text Area, and Image, plus control of the output HTML tag.

Insert imported templates — starter sections (Hero, features, CTA layouts, and more); one click adds them to the Elementor library and creates the ACF Flow Starter field group automatically. Pro layouts are marked on the cards.
